summary: Under the challenge RH foundation the multiplicity-weighted matrix is a positive Gram matrix. Its diagonal controls the number of distinct zeros and its off-diagonal squares dominate the pair energy of all distinct interior locations. Applying the Bakken / Bei Yi / Opeth ten-point spacing certificate to these locations strengthens the bound in dyadic windows. Zeta23 gives the cumulative bound. Developed with OpenAI Codex. Upstream notices remain in the source.
method: Ten-point spacing applied to all distinct critical-line locations
